name: PuffPAI Desktop
description: The default Desktop, with the look and pages of the first BuildBot: Home, Chat, Apps, Building, Your turn, Developer, People, Settings, Vault, Knowledge, the Agent Team and what leaves your computer. Built only on the Core API; swap it for any other ui package.

consent: The Desktop is plain files served by the Core on this computer. Nothing leaves your computer without your consent.
